notes.title: Who is Jamboy? Billy Explains | VLog #1
notes.content:
[p]As the September 25th release date for [b]Jamboy, A Jelly-Cious Hero[/b] slowly looms larger and larger on the horizon, we wanted to get into the rhythm of sharing more about the game with you via our new Dev Log series. As words aren't quite as sweet as video, we wanted to do this in video form, too. [/p][p][/p][p]And so, in this debut post, we start at the most natural place possible: with [strike]Jamboy[/strike] [strike]himself[/strike] Billy. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jhT-JLnIwTM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]There is more light to shine on the world and characters of Jamboy, which we'll be looking at in subsequent posts, but for now, we hope you have a better understand of what a powerful, heroic and valiant hero our [strike]Jamboy[/strike] Billy is. notes.title: The Jamboy Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hungry? Good, because the [b]Jamboy, A Jelly-Cious Hero[/b] demo is now live as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and ready for you to dig in.
 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395068/62cc9212c3feabe8cd23a1a3d9b4cd8c8761568b.png"][/img]

The [b]Jamboy[/b] demo features the first two levels from World 1, the first two from World 2 and one additional Lost Level. The full game will have 2 worlds across eight levels, in addition to two boss fights and a further 5 Lost Levels.  Oh, and some big news for Next Fest. [b]Jamboy, A Jelly-Cious Hero [/b]will launch on [b]September 25th, 2025.[/b] Mark your diaries! [/p][p][/p][h2]Let us know what you think of the demo![/h2][p]Played the demo? We'd love to know what you thought of it. If you have a spare moment, we've set up a little form to capture your feedback. Everybody that completes the form will be entered into a Draw to win a copy of the game at launch. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSffOhV3L82lvA0sK4t500xALVk2JL2LghKi4apbvsDMFQ66Og/viewform?usp=header" style="button"]Tell us what you thought! [/url][/p][h2]
Watch an Exclusive Jamboy Dev Stream[/h2][p]As part of our Next Fest activities, you can an exclusive stream of the game with the game's Lead Designer, Nestiboy, who walks through the demo with exclusive director's commentary [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198319908248" style="button"]Watch here![/url][/p][p] [/p][h2]Get Your Jamboy Wallpaper! [/h2][p]We’ve set up a newsletter! And everybody that signs up (as well as getting exclusive Jamboy news and behind the scenes updates) will instantly get an exclusive wallpaper of the new artwork - including resolutions for both desktop and mobile. You can [url="https://vidibondgames.com/newsletter/"]sign up here[/url]. And no spam, just jam. We promise. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395068/ba544562bf44e08d0da444be8f91ce23d06b1a95.png"][/img][/p][p]That's it for now - we hope you enjoy the demo! [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, please add Jamboy to your wishlist - and we'll be back with more updates very soon indeed... notes.title: Jamboy Gets Jammier!
notes.content:
Your favourite squishy hero has had a bit of a glow-up, or at least his home here on Steam has. We've just rolled out some sweet new artwork for the game - fresher, glossier, just a little bit more… jammy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395068/ab3ae474dd0f3b756aa73954a9adceaf9ba9988d.png[/img]

Snazzy, yes? Jamboy's Steam page has had a lick of paint, but we thought - to celebrate this glow up - we'd go a step further.  

We’ve set up a newsletter! And everybody that signs up (as well as getting exclusive Jamboy news and behind the scenes updates) will instantly get an exclusive wallpaper of the new artwork - including resolutions for both desktop and mobile. You can [url=https://vidibondgames.com/newsletter/]sign up here[/url]. And no spam, just jam. We promise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395068/ba544562bf44e08d0da444be8f91ce23d06b1a95.png[/img]

Oh, and here’s a little something to round things off: the first [b]public demo[/b] of Jamboy, A Jelly-Cious Hero lands next week. Squish up some space in your calendar accordingly - we can't wait to see what you think.

In the meantime, please add Jamboy to your wishlist - and we'll be back with more updates very soon indeed...
